sources.label: Morphe patches to remove ads, analytics, apk junk, debug info, duplicate graphic
sources.author: BlazeFTL
patch_list: Disables caller ID features, the phone state receiver and the permission settings entry.
Skips the consent form request on launch and continues the splash flow directly.
Skips the phone, overlay and notification permission pages in the initial setup.
Stops the app from hiding the system navigation bar.
Makes the app treat itself as purchased.
